Specification: This module specifies trace validation for an implementation of the EWD998 channel-based termination-detection system by relating implementation log entries to steps of a higher-level TLA+ model imported from EWD998Chan. It deserializes a JSON log, reorders distributed log entries into causal order using vector clocks, constrains each trace line to correspond to a particular high-level action or to stuttering for unmodeled termination messages, and uses TLC breadth-first search together with a custom trace view to permit repeated high-level states along the trace. The specification also defines a postcondition TraceAccepted to check that the entire log matches a prefix of some behavior, includes an invariant about failure-free log entries and termination messages, and provides a debugging alias exposing enabledness and selected state information.
